summary: All four printed pages closely match the official 2018 ENCS PDF; needs form-local tweaks for Page 1 Items 19-20 checkbox geometry and Page 3 Schedule 6.A.1 Row 8 microscopic font size, plus shared print fixes for comb ticks and schedule amount alignment.

defects.where: Page 1 Item 9 Registered Address, Page 2 Part IV Item 5 Spouse's Name, Page 3 Schedule 5 Descriptions
defects.what: Long text overflows comb boxes and collides directly with comb tick marks.

defects.where: Page 1, Part I Items 19 and 20 (Income EXEMPT / SPECIAL-PREFERENTIAL RATE checkboxes)
defects.what: Yes/No checkbox inputs are vertically compressed so the X mark touches the top and bottom borders compared to the official PDF.
Large or negative computed amounts exceeding 9 comb slots print completely blank.
NOLCO schedule amounts print left-aligned without thousand separators right against the left cell borders.

defects.where: Page 3, Schedule 6.A.1 Row 8 (Total NOLCO - Taxpayer/Filer, column D)
defects.what: Total amount renders at a microscopic font size (~2-3pt), far smaller than the matching Row 13 Spouse Total NOLCO on Page 4.

defects.where: Page 4, bottom reference tables (Table 1 and Table 2 Tax Rates)
defects.what: Reference tax rate tables are moved out of the filed sheet into guide.html per provenance.json.

shared_changes_wanted: crates/bir-print (owned by neon-4 on try/forms-shared-print): mask comb ticks under overflowing long text, right-align/pad schedule amounts in Schedule 6.A.1/6.A.2, and handle >9-digit/negative comb overflow in Schedule 3.A.
open_questions: Print preview window opens natively on Linux via WebKitGTK; full unclipped 1400px-wide print-p*.png pages were rendered from the running app's generated sheet.html via headless Chrome --print-to-pdf + pypdfium2.
